notes: This contract pins the embedded Connection Lost scenario to the exact IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ FederateAmbassador callback. The callback is invoked on a best-effort basis after the private transport endpoint forces the member out of the execution; the directive cases validate configured DELETE_OBJECTS, UNCONDITIONALLY_DIVEST_ATTRIBUTES, DELETE_OBJECTS_THEN_DIVEST, CANCEL_PENDING_OWNERSHIP_ACQUISITIONS, and CANCEL_THEN_DELETE_THEN_DIVEST automatic-resign dispositions before that callback. It is source/API traceability only; protected review, package support, remote transport, and conformance remain open.
